newsitem.title: UK: British Airways firm amid stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: British Airways firm amid stock shortage.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc defied the general UK stock market gloom on Thursday after institutional buying late yesterday left some market-makers short of stock, dealers said.
The stock was up 1/2p at 600 by 0855 GMT, one of only four FTSE 100 stocks to show a gain at that point, with the overall index down 24.7 points at 4,062.8.
"There was decent support last night and there was a buyer at the six pound level," said one market maker. "The stock has held this level very well over the past four to five weeks."
"There was some institutional interest yesterday and the market is a bit short of the stock," another said.
British Airways is still in the throes of negotiating its proposed transatlantic alliance with American Airlines, news of which boosted the stock last October.
A report in the Independent newspaper this week said rival U.S. airlines would call on the U.S. authorities to impose harsher conditions on the transatlantic alliance than those proposed by the UK.
